copy.tagline: 引导你快速熟悉陌生项目的代码库、开发环境与架构。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚加入团队，正面对一个陌生项目不知从何入手。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to a codebase and need to quickly get up to speed with the environment and architecture.

howto.what: 进入本项目的新会话时，先读取README、AGENTS等顶层文件和src目录，再查看git日志与分支，然后介绍Project-Q（量子-经典混合风险引擎）架构，列出关键文件、常用命令，并检查长期记忆。
howto.when: 当首次探索代码库、搭建开发环境或理解项目架构时，以及在新会话进入本项目时触发。

say.text: 我刚接手这个项目，先帮我梳理一下整体架构。
say.note: 它会读顶层文件和git状态，给出架构概览。

say.text: 这个项目怎么搭建开发环境？有哪些常用命令？
say.note: 它会列出构建、运行、测试等命令。

say.text: Project-Q的量子模块和测试分别在哪里？
say.note: 它会按关键文件表指出位置。

howto.what_en: On a new session for this project, it reads top-level files like README and AGENTS and the src directory, checks git log and branches, then explains the architecture of Project-Q (a quantum-classical hybrid risk engine), lists key files, common commands, and checks long-term memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when first exploring the codebase, setting up the dev environment, or understanding the project architecture, as well as on entering a new session for the project.

say_en.text: I just joined this project, give me an outline of the architecture.
say_en.note: It reads top files and git state, then gives an overview.

say_en.text: How do I set up the dev environment and what commands are common?
say_en.note: It lists build, run, test commands.

say_en.text: Where are the quantum module and tests in Project-Q?
say_en.note: It points them out from the key files table.
